import heapq
import sys

def main():
    for line in sys.stdin:
        n = int(line.strip())
        pq = []
        for _ in range(n):
            x = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
            heapq.heappush(pq, x)
        k = n // 2
        for _ in range(k):
            heapq.heappop(pq)
        print(pq[0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
